title: Vehicle emissions - federal and state boundary
facts: EPA sets federal vehicle and engine emissions standards, but vehicle inspection and emissions-testing requirements for owners are implemented through state or local programs where applicable.
Not every state or county requires periodic emissions testing.
California has authority under the Clean Air Act waiver framework to establish certain vehicle-emission standards, and other states may adopt qualifying California standards under federal law.
A driver's testing deadline, exemption or inspection procedure therefore requires state and often county or metro-area information.
